method: No fresh WebSearch was possible: the session search budget was already spent (200 of 200) when this refuter ran, and direct fetches are blocked. Every record was tested instead against evidence already in the house: the server guide built from the house menus read 26 September 2026 (guide.txt), the page snapshots of 3 October, and the earlier verified and refuted research. Held means the guide, a snapshot or an earlier verified record agrees on the item and any price or vintage; refuted means one of those contradicts it; unverifiable means the sweep snippet stands alone. Records that rest only on the sweep snippet were not re-searched and stay unverifiable however strong the snippet.
